repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly placed the cycle counter `n` inside the sustain block, causing the loop to terminate after only 2 ticks (20 seconds) instead of 30 seconds. The IR requires the condition to be sustained for 30 seconds, then execute the cycle body exactly twice (until n >= 2). The candidate broke the loop at n=2 before the 30-second threshold was reached, and the structure fails to separate the sustain duration from the cycle repetition count.
changed_locations: script logic structure, counter placement, period setting
diagnosis.change_summary: Reset `period` to 100ms to enable the tick counter. Moved the `n` counter outside the sustain block to track the cycle repetitions correctly. Implemented the sustain logic with a threshold of 301 (30 seconds at 100ms granularity + 1 for the initial tick). Once the sustain condition is met, the script executes the body action, delays 15 seconds, and repeats the action once more before breaking. This ensures the sustain window completes fully before the cycle begins, and the cycle runs exactly twice as specified.
